g.text: MELD: compare the vote rules within each model group
Every point is labelled with its required matching votes; square = all models agree.
Colours identify model groups, not stronger or weaker confidence guarantees.
Mixed3: emotion2vec+ + Gemini + Qwen2.5-Omni. SER+API7: five SER + GPT + Gemini.
A group that accepts fewer samples can still make a larger fraction of errors on those samples.
